senses.def: a stimulant drug that is chemically related to mescaline and amphetamine and is used illicitly for its euphoric and hallucinogenic effects; it was formerly used in psychotherapy but in 1985 it was declared illegal in the United States
ex: MDMA is often used at parties because it enables partygoers to remain active for long periods of time

senses.def: 3,4-methylenedioxymethamphetamine, a synthetic entactogen of the methylenedioxyphenethylamine family.
Abbreviation of Madam; a polite form of address and title used before a (usually middle-aged) adult or elderly woman's surname, full name or given name if she does not have a family name.
